name: covid-blend-candidate-20261125
description: DRAFT candidate from experiments/covid-rsv-search-20261124 (not installed, for the user to decide). The submitted covid-gru-four mixture (Ah.neighbors, pN.enc_gru, N.multiscale, Bh.wd) plus two members from the 20 Nov search: T (GRU, direct quantiles, US-only summary, real-pair correction trees) and S (sampled GRU, US-only summary, network on tree-corrected histories, real-pair trees); six recipes, equal weights. Each refit on all of 2022-23 through 2025-26, labels the finalized future COVID admissions and ED shares as of 12 Nov 2026, artificial reporting errors drawn from 2025-26, 80 seeds (42-121) per recipe, on panel-coverage.npz (the weekly pipeline must build the coverage panel). Held-out seasons (48 seeds, against the submitted mixture refit the same way): log-admission WIS -1.24% (2 SE 0.30%), lower in both seasons, rising -3.3%, peak weeks -2.4%, falling -0.3%, ED share -1.0%; 2023-24 guard (64 seeds) -0.8%, ED share -4.8%. The three-member alternative draft-release-covid-tns.json is -2.0% on held-out seasons and -5.6% in peak weeks but +0.6% on 2023-24. Checkpoints in the Longleaf campaign folder nowcast-20261113.
